ctx.x: I had to buy a clarinet and learn it and boy, sucking, and squeaking, and squawking and oh man. LINDA: Tell them the story about the penny in the -­

Ah, yeah. We -- when we opened up in, at Lesley Elgams (phonetic sp.) I think we were playing and there was a -- Oh no. It was Sandler and Young (phonetic sp.) and they opened up with a thing called a street scene [sings]. And it opened up with this thing was on clarinet and I blew in the clarinet and nothing came out. And I was like, oh my. Perspiration was popping out on my head, you know, and I didn't realize it, but just Jimmy Molodor was standing off on the side dying laughing because he had put a penny in…
